page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r9i.8xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual server running on the KVM hypervisor. The instance is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor running at 3.2 GHz, delivering 32 dedicated virtual CPU cores. It provides 256 GB of main memory, maintaining a generous memory-to-core allocation of 8.0 GB per vCPU for data-intensive processing.

This server type does not feature local storage disks, requiring external cloud block storage for operating systems and persistence layers. It includes no hardware GPU accelerators. Network connectivity is rated at a baseline throughput of 20 Gbps, accommodating high-throughput data exchange across cloud services and clustered environments without complimentary public IPv4 addressing.

The 8:1 memory-to-core ratio provides cost efficiency for memory-bound tasks by eliminating the need to over-provision compute cores solely to acquire required RAM capacity. The absence of bundled local storage requires architectural reliance on network-attached storage, which introduces external I/O considerations. Alibaba Cloud ecs.r9i.8xlarge is suited for in-memory databases, large caching clusters, distributed big data processing, enterprise ERP systems, and memory-heavy analytics pipelines.
